parameters.help_en: The name of the VOD packaging asset
parameters.name: asset_name

schema.description_en: The query result for VOD packaging assets
schema.description_zh: 查询点播打包资产结果

Asset.description_en: The details of the VOD packaging asset

AssetName.description_en: The name of the packaging asset

ContentId.description_en: The content ID in the Digital Rights Management (DRM) system. The format is [A-Za-z0-9_-]+, and the maximum length is 256 characters
ContentId.description_zh: DRM系统中的内容id，格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+，长度最多256
ContentId.title_en: DRM系统中的内容id，格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+，长度最多256。
ContentId.title_zh: DRM系统中的内容id，格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+，长度最多256。

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the asset was created. The format is 2024-11-21T06:45:32Z, which indicates 2024-11-21 14:45:32 in UTC+8

EgressEndpoints.description_en: The list of output endpoints for asset packaging and playback. Each packaging configuration corresponds to one packaging playback endpoint
EgressEndpoints.description_zh: 资产打包播放输出端点列表，一个打包配置对应一个打包播放端点

ConfigurationName.description_en: The name of the packaging configuration

Status.description_en:
The status. Valid values:
Queuing: Queued for processing.
Playable: Playable.
Failed: Packaging failed and playback is unavailable
Status.description_zh:
状态，支持值：
Queuing：排队处理中；
Playable: 可以播放；
Failed：打包失败，无法播放
Status.title_en:
状态，支持值：

Playable: 可以播放；
Failed：打包失败，无法播放。
Status.title_zh:
状态，支持值：

Url.description_en: The playback URL. If asset packaging fails, the corresponding playback URL is not returned
Url.description_zh: 播放URL，当资产打包失败时不返回对应的播放URL
Url.title_en: 播放URL，当资产打包失败时不返回对应的播放URL。
Url.title_zh: 播放URL，当资产打包失败时不返回对应的播放URL。

EgressEndpoints.title_zh: 资产打包播放输出端点列表，一个打包配置对应一个打包播放端点。

GroupName.description_en: The name of the packaging group

Input.description_en: The input of the packaging asset

Media.description_en: The input media asset. Currently, only OSS paths are supported, such as OSS://test-bucket/video/202208/test.m3u8. Only inputs with the .m3u8 extension are supported
Media.description_zh: 输入媒资，目前只支持OSS路径，如 OSS://test-bucket/video/202208/test.m3u8。只支持后缀为.m3u8的输入

Type.description_en: The input type. Currently, only Object Storage Service (OSS) is supported
